title: Compile report (dist/<os>/<arch>/<version>/build_report.json)
description: Per-pattern outcome of `ai-prompt-guard compile`. A pattern that Hyperscan rejects (or that takes too long) is first retried as a prefilter (PCRE2 must be able to confirm it), then with its big counted repeats relaxed; if that also fails it is isolated here with the exact error, the rules that use it and its upstream provenance, so one bad expression never loses the rest of the rule set.

downgraded_to_prefilter.description: Native by static analysis, but Hyperscan needed prefilter mode

relaxed_repeats.description: Prefilter patterns that were compiled with their big counted repeats relaxed ({m,n} -> {m,}); PCRE2 confirms every candidate

build_stats.description: How the build ran (parallelism and limits); informational

jobs.description: Worker threads (0: the pcre2_fallback backend compiles nothing)

native_timeout_s.description: Limit of an attempt that a relaxed fallback can still rescue

pattern_timeout_s.description: Limit of the last-chance attempt of a pattern

relax_repeat.description: Counted repeats above this bound may be relaxed in the last-resort prefilter form; 0 = off

elapsed_s.description: Seconds until the report was written

relaxed_repeats.description: Compiled in prefilter mode with its big counted repeats relaxed
